mesh_slice_contours — PRINTPATH slice op

• Data kinds: mesh → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.mesh_slice_contours(mesh: 'Any', z: 'float', tol: 'float' = 1e-06) -> 'dict[str, np.ndarray]' (to call the implementation directly, import printpath; printpath.mesh_slice_contours(mesh: 'Any', z: 'float', tol: 'float' = 1e-06) -> 'dict[str, np.ndarray]'; from the registry, opsprintpath.get("mesh_slice_contours"))

Usage

Table of contours table obtained by cutting a triangle mesh with the plane z: columns ring (ring number), x, y (mm).

Make the intersection of each triangle and the plane into a line segment, orient it by the triangle's normal (counterclockwise for the contour, clockwise for the hole), and set the endpoints to Butt them together and connect them into a closed ring (or an open chain if not closed) (classical slicer). The contents and hole can be determined by the signed area of ​​the ring. When the vertex is exactly on the plane, lift it by 2*tol + 1e-12 to avoid degeneration. ValueError if the plane does not touch the shape (An empty layer says "no").
